open scoped BigOperators

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_1_1_18 {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (x y : G) : (x * y = y * x ↔ y⁻¹ * x * y = x) ∧ (y⁻¹ * x * y = x ↔ x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ * x * y = 1) := by
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro h
      calc
        y⁻¹ * x * y = y⁻¹ * (x * y) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = y⁻¹ * (y * x) := by rw [h]
        _ = (y⁻¹ * y) * x := by rw [← mul_assoc]
        _ = 1 * x := by rw [inv_mul_cancel]
        _ = x := by rw [one_mul]
    · intro h
      calc
        x * y = 1 * (x * y) := by rw [one_mul]
        _ = (y * y⁻¹) * (x * y) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
        _ = y * (y⁻¹ * x * y) := by simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = y * x := by rw [h]
  · constructor
    · intro h
      calc
        x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ * x * y = x⁻¹ * (y⁻¹ * x * y) := by simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = x⁻¹ * x := by rw [h]
        _ = 1 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel]
    · intro h
      calc
        y⁻¹ * x * y = 1 * (y⁻¹ * x * y) := by rw [one_mul]
        _ = (x * x⁻¹) * (y⁻¹ * x * y) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
        _ = x * (x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ * x * y) := by simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = x * 1 := by rw [h]
        _ = x := by rw [mul_one]

  (x y : G) : (x * y = y * x ↔ y⁻¹ * x * y = x) ∧ (y⁻¹ * x * y = x ↔ x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ * x * y = 1) := by

      _ = x := by simp

          _ = y * (y⁻¹ * x * y) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
          _ = y * (y⁻¹ * x * y) := by rfl
      _ = y * x := by

    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_part1_forward h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_part1_backward h
